name: Solo jazz guitar for a holiday party: White Christmas
description: One jazz guitarist plays White Christmas here, at a volume that suits a holiday dinner. We can also play these songs as a trio with upright bass and drums.
more: Our Christmas song list also has The Christmas Song, Let It Snow and Winter Wonderland, with jazz standards like Fly Me to the Moon and The Girl from Ipanema mixed in. Let us know how much Christmas you want in the music. If you'd like dancing, we can add a singer or a horn to the trio and play swing.
